title.zh: LobeHub：从开源聊天工具到首席Agent官的演进之路
title.en: LobeHub: From Open-Source Chat Tool to Chief Agent Operator

intro.zh: LobeHub 从 2023 年的开源聊天工具 LobeChat 起步，历经三次重大架构变革与两次品牌定位转型，最终发展为以「首席 Agent 运营官」（CAO）为核心的多智能体协作平台。本报告系统梳理其完整发展脉络、技术架构演进、商业模式探索与生态系统建设。
intro.en: LobeHub began in 2023 as the open-source chat tool LobeChat, went through three major architectural overhauls and two repositionings, and became a multi-agent collaboration platform built around the "Chief Agent Operator" (CAO). This report traces its full trajectory: architecture, business model, and ecosystem.

headline.zh: 8.12 万 star · 1.58 万 fork · TypeScript · 2023 年 5 月建仓

blurb.zh: 创始人徐文彬，Ant Design 核心成员出身。仓库里 43% 的人类提交出自他手，过去 30 天抽样的 400 个已合并 PR 里有 117 个是他提的——这既是项目的引擎，也是它最大的单点风险。
blurb.en: Founder Arvin Xu, formerly a core member of Ant Design. He wrote 43% of the repo's human commits and authored 117 of the 400 recently merged PRs we sampled — the project's engine, and its single biggest point of failure.

blurb.zh: 11 年账号、1,755 个已合并 PR、名下项目累计 13 万 star。他在 LobeHub 只提交了 224 次，但这类「在别处已经证明过自己」的人愿意来，本身就是项目成色的一个信号。
blurb.en: An 11-year-old account with 1,755 merged PRs and 130k stars across their projects. Only 224 commits here — but people who have already proven themselves elsewhere choosing to show up is itself a signal about a project.

blurb.zh: 715 次提交，仓库人类提交量第三。个人简介里写着 mx-space、Afilmory 等自有项目，1,315 个已合并 PR——典型的「自己有作品，还愿意给别人的项目写代码」那一类开发者。
blurb.en: 715 commits, third among humans in this repo. Runs their own projects (mx-space, Afilmory) with 1,315 merged PRs on top — the kind of developer who ships their own work and still writes code for someone else's.

blurb.zh: 810 次提交，人类里排第二，近 30 天抽样中提交了 74 个已合并 PR。600 个已合并 PR、8 年账号，是这个仓库日常吞吐量的另一根柱子。
blurb.en: 810 commits — second among humans — and 74 merged PRs in our 30-day sample. 600 merged PRs on an eight-year-old account: the other pillar holding up this repo's daily throughput.

blurb.zh: 32 个关注者、名下仓库总共 58 个 star，引擎给了 90.7 分——因为 14 年账号龄和 391 个已合并 PR 骗不了人。这类人正是 star 榜看不见、引擎能看见的样本。
blurb.en: 32 followers, 58 stars across their repos — and an engine score of 90.7, because a 14-year-old account with 391 merged PRs cannot be faked. Exactly the kind of contributor a star ranking misses and an engine does not.
